name: Alt Almanac
summary: See the level, gold, location and rested bonus of every character on your account in a single window.
logoPrompt: A thick closed leather-bound almanac with brass corner fittings, a small silver bookmark ribbon hanging out and a few gold coins stacked against its spine

cover.tagline: All your characters at a glance.
bullets: Level, gold and zone per character

description: **Alt Almanac keeps one page for every character you play, so you know who is ready to level, who holds the gold and where everyone was left.**
- One row per character: name in class colour, level, gold, zone and when you last played it.
- Rested bonus for each character. For the ones you are not playing it keeps growing, faster for those who logged out in an inn or a city.
- Total gold of all your characters.
- Sorted by level, then by name, in a window you can drag anywhere.
Log in once with each character so it is added. Type `/aa` (or `/altalmanac`) to open or close the list, Escape closes it too. `/aa forget Name-Realm` removes a character you deleted.
- Works on Retail. No combat data and no chat parsing.
- Resting characters are shown in blue. The bonus is capped at one and a half levels, at maximum level it shows a dash.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
